newsitem.title: USA: Baldor Electric names new president.
newsitem.headline: Baldor Electric names new president.

text.p: Baldor Electric Co said on Tuesday it named John McFarland, executive vice president of sales and marketing, as president, and it appointed Chief Executive Officer R.L. Qualls as vice chairman.
Qualls, who had also been president of the company, would remain CEO, Baldor said. The vice chairman position was a newly-created job, it said.
Chief Financial Officer, Secretary and Treasurer Lloyd Davis was named executive vice president of finance, but would retain his other roles, Baldor said.
James Kimzey was named executive vice president of research and engineering, the company said. He joined Baldor in 1982 and has been an officer since 1986, it said.
